technique_name: List the differences between a data scientist and a data analyst.
description: A data scientist and a data analyst have different functions and roles. A data analyst typically focuses on data collection, cleaning, and interpretation, while a data scientist may analyze more complex data and provide insights from it. A data scientist may also use machine learning and deep learning to gain understanding from datasets while a data analyst focuses more on exploratory analysis.
